fields.notes: This Physical Layer Simplified Spec defines bus electrical parameters (Section 6.6 / 6.7) but no internal PDK / floorplan / SDC content. SD host controller IPs (e.g. SDHCI) ship their own SDC + UPF + DFT.
host_pcb_constraints_summary: Bypass cap on VDD near slot.
Signal-integrity routing for UHS-I SDR50 (100 MHz) and SDR104 (208 MHz).
VDDIO supply with controllable 3.3 V ↔ 1.8 V switch for UHS-I.
fields.card_internal_constraints: Card-internal PDK / SDC / layout constraints are vendor-specific and intentionally out of scope. Card-side electrical signoff is at the bus-interface pads only (Section 6 of this spec).

extraction_hints: Look for floorplan, area, power, timing constraints.
ic_name: SD Memory Card (SD Simplified Physical Layer Specification)
